status_at_definition: frozen before acquisition or inspection of any lagged joint response
question: Can early cluster geometry invisible to its immediate rank alter later rank entry/exit and the original U?
lag_rule: ell=ceil(sqrt(N)), integer arithmetic; sole selected lag; no lag scan
raw_source: s_L=C_B(L)+C_W(N-L), bulk integer component count on the old permutation
centered_source: z_K=s_L-E[s_L|L,r_L,g], separately within each geometry and early rank at each fixed L
positive_path_measure: joint (K,permutation) baseline Bin(N,p)*uniform(old-engine order), tilted globally by exp(t*z_K), or by exp(t*s_L) for the raw control
p_derivative: ell,L(K), and the microcanonical conditional means are fixed as p changes; differentiate only Bin(N,p) weights. K-indexed source is part of the specified path measure. No extra derivative of L or fitted means.
immediate_constraint: E[z_K f(L,r_L,g)|K,g]=0, hence each early rank probability and every K-only observable has zero first response; this does not force late q_K/E_K response to zero
centered_strata: report z_K*I[r_L=r] for r=0,1,2; their sum is z_K. r=2 has zero late response by monotonic rank. Within r=1, late entry is already constant and cannot respond; only exit can respond.
original_U: N^(13/8)*P4[d_p E_K]/(2*mean_g d_p q_K), at original pooled matching root, exact delta cos4 retained
inference: original three source dependence groups, 100 aligned delete-one batches; each omission recomputes all conditional means and uses that omission's previously saved pooled root; full common covariance, signed outputs, no clipping
old_samples: N65/85/130/170 first100k; N260/340 first1M, with batch b = first1000 offset1000b union added9000 offset100000+9000b; same two geometry permutation
baseline_validation: exact integer reproduction of every original batch/K q,E,s,qs,Es before scoring; old U, source response, and roots reconstructed on central and retained samples
scope: new lagged path-source tangent on the six original finite tori, not decomposition of the old equal-time source derivative; empirical centering is descriptive and re-estimated, not independently frozen physical intervention; no continuum field assignment or asymptotic lag scaling claim
decision: resolved late response with exact immediate zero demonstrates a finite predictive geometry channel beyond instantaneous rank; unresolved U response is reported as such; zero late response bounds this one source/lag and is not proof of global rank sufficiency
